title: Align and distribute buttons arrange the selected nodes
body: With 2 or more nodes selected the toolbar shows align left, centre, right, top, middle and bottom; with 3 or more, distribute horizontally and vertically, keeping the outer two in place and making the gaps between neighbouring boxes equal. A library `arrange_edits(source, &[(Span, dx, dy)])` applies a separate offset per node as one edit, so one undo step; arrows between the nodes follow by name. Nodes a stack or grid places are refused, as for a move.
close_reason: Landed in 301a2a1. `scene::edit::arrange_edits` writes an offset per node as one list of edits, and `move_edits` calls it. An `at` that names a node arranged by another offset takes the difference in its `DX DY`. An end, a marker or a brace on such a node is refused. acre-gui's `arrange` module holds the align and spacing maths (`offsets`, `bounds`, `outermost`), and `App::arrange` writes the result through `App::write`.
